units.source_en: Toshiie suddenly felt cold all over and stood frozen in the shadow of the tree.
units.source_zh: 利家忽感全身冰冷，呆呆站在树荫里。

paragraphs.source_zh: 於大咬着牙，痴痴凝视着眼前的儿子。利家忽感全身冰冷，呆呆站在树荫里。
